adopted.prompt: Precise UI asset extraction/edit, not redesign. Input is an enlarged crop of the approved Wave plaque. Keep the EXACT visible plaque outline, all FOUR asymmetric rounded/chamfered corner contours, worn muted bronze/grey rail thickness, corner notches, uneven dark patina and weak highlights. Do NOT turn it into a generic smooth capsule, shiny gold frame, uniformly rounded rectangle or polished silver. Change ONLY: remove all text 'Wave: 3/31' completely and reconstruct the same matte graphite stone beneath it; remove every green leaf, vine, moss tuft and all neighboring header-bar fragments outside the plaque. Preserve the dark neutral grey center brightness and fine shallow marks, keep the rim understated and weathered. Where vegetation hides a few pixels, continue the neighboring contour minimally without inventing ornate trim. Background outside plaque fully transparent; center opaque. The plaque left edge is about 6% inside this crop and its right edge near the far right. Reframe the isolated plaque to fill 98% of a long horizontal canvas while preserving its ORIGINAL approximately 5.85:1 geometry. No letters or numbers, no decorative gussets. Match the input's shapes and original colors as literally as possible; higher detail must not change geometry or lighting.

adopted.operation: byte-for-byte copy, importer size limit 400, native AtlasTexture and fixed 20px corners
